# MorningstarrAI

> MorningstarrAI builds AI automations for marketing agencies and other businesses: replying to comments and DMs, following up new leads, turning one piece of content into ten, client reporting, onboarding and admin, so agencies can take on more clients without hiring more people. Its Automation Sprint automates one process, live within 5 working days, and can be bought online for £6,525. Founded by Manthan Bhendkar; owned by Asendify (asendify.co). Tools: n8n, Make, Google Apps Script and custom code, set up in accounts the client owns.

## Buy online
- Automation Sprint: £6,525 at https://playbook.asendify.co/sprint (£4,500 + 45% service fee). One process automated end to end: workflow audit and system design, one process automated, tested and live, handover docs and a recorded walkthrough, 30 days of fixes. Payment first, then a call where the buyer describes the process; the automation goes live within 5 working days after that call. Buyers in India request an invoice.

## Engagements (GBP; a 45% service fee applies on top of every fee)
- Automation Sprint: £4,500 fixed price (£6,525 including the service fee when bought online, see above).
- AI Outbound Engine: £4,500 fixed price. The cold-email system MorningstarrAI runs daily, set up on the client's inboxes: daily lead finding, personalised first lines, 2 follow-ups, AI replies that qualify leads and send a booking link, deliverability setup and a daily report. Live in 5 days.
- Agency Operating System: from £12,000 one-off. 3 to 5 connected systems across the agency, built on its CRM, project tool and data sources, with team training, one operations dashboard and 60 days of fixes.
- Managed Automation Partner: from £2,500 per month. Monitoring, fixes, new builds every month, priority WhatsApp support and a monthly review.
- AI Content Engine: £3,000 per month + £1,500 one-time setup, 3-month minimum, 3 client spots. A done-for-you faceless YouTube channel in the client's own cloned voice (cloned from a 2-minute sample, with written consent): 30 Shorts and 8 long-form videos a month, scripts, editing, uploading and a monthly report; first videos live within 7 days.
- No invented results: MorningstarrAI does not publish client results it does not have; it runs the same systems on its own agency, Asendify, every day.

## Free tool
- [Automation ROI Calculator](https://morningstarr.asendify.co/automation-roi-calculator/): Enter how long a task takes, how often it is done each week and the hourly cost of the person doing it to see hours and money saved per month and per year, plus payback time for a build cost you enter. Free, runs in the browser.
- Who it's for: agency owners and business owners deciding whether a task is worth automating.
